title: Well-posedness in $L^2$ for nonlocal NLS in the full subcritical range of symbol growth
summary: In this paper, we study a class of one-dimensional nonlocal nonlinear Schrödinger equations on the line with nonlinearity given by a Fourier multiplier whose symbol has subcritical high-frequency growth. In terms of symbol order, this class is intermediate between the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation and the Calogero--Moser derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation. We prove local well-posedness in $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ throughout the full scaling-subcritical range. Due to derivative loss, the standard Duhamel integral is not directly meaningful for rough data.
